name: Airport Pickups London
description: Book UK airport and cruise port transfers with fixed prices. Get instant quotes, validate flights, create real bookings, track drivers, and manage reservations for all London airports (Heathrow, Gatwick, Stansted, Luton, City),  and UK cruise ports. Includes trip planner for round trips and group travel.
longDescription:
Ships **5 skills**, **1 agent**, **2 commands** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (5): `book` (This skill should be used when the user wants to book an airport transfer, reserve a taxi, make…), `faq` (This skill should be used when the user asks questions about Airport Pickups London's services, policies, vehicles, payment,…), `quote` (This skill should be used when the user asks for airport transfer prices, taxi quotes, cab fares, or…), `setup` (This skill activates when the user installs the Airport Pickups London plugin, or asks to set up, configure,…), `validate-flight` (This skill should be used when the user provides a flight number during a transfer booking, or asks…)
- **Agents** (1): `trip-planner` (A sub-agent that handles multi-leg transfer planning)
- **Commands** (2): `apl-booking` (Look up, amend, or cancel an Airport Pickups London booking), `apl-quote` (Get an airport transfer quote from Airport Pickups London)
- **MCP servers** (1): `airport-pickups-london`

Installs with `claude plugin install airport-pickups-london@claude-community` from `mfy-apl/claude-plugin-airport-pickups-london`.
